opportunities.title: Put pallets into warehouse storage racks
opportunities.summary: Collect a prepared pallet and place it at an agreed storage position. Rack clearance, load capacity and inventory confirmation need a configured system.

reviewLinks.rationale: Manufacturer describes pallet lifting into storage or low station positions.
limitations: AGILOX OCF is limited to low stations; Linde height remains subject to residual capacity and configuration.
Validate rack interface, load geometry and confirmation workflow.
